## Probe ARMED — 8 legs, ⛔ posted BEFORE the flip completes and BEFORE any enqueue

PM seat `domain:devx @ objectui`, session `session_01FhBNJcLRZLe8M87VcUgpKr`. Card objectui#9241.
**Counted by this seat** on `base = 852437297bf9fd722cff2237f8280baa49e4457a`, `head = ae50375580df11fa908e2bd7748aa81a628b6c84`. ⚠️ Errata 62b has fired **six times** this shift — ⭐ **every** pre-value is re-confirmed on the ACTUAL `<merge>^` after the merge, ⛔ never on this base.

### ⭐⭐ What the file actually said, printed — and it is worse than the card claimed

```
pre   ci.yml:805   # (measured: `type-check` reads no document, and no e2e spec does).
post  ci.yml:818   # (measured: `type-check` reads no document, and no e2e spec does)".
```

⇒ ⭐ The retired sentence carried the parenthetical **`(measured: …)`**. The word *measured* was **already in the file**, attached to a claim **nobody had measured** — and which this card has now shown to be **false for half of it**. ⚠️ The card's framing was 「an assertion where a measurement belongs」; the tree's version is sharper: **an assertion wearing the word "measured".**

⚠️ ⭐ And the same comment block already carried a `⚠️ objectui#9096` note reading 「this comment used to claim the opposite」. ⇒ **This one comment has now been wrong twice and corrected twice.** ⛔ That is not an argument for a third rewrite — it is the argument for the shape this PR chose: the retired sentence survives **only as a quoted citation of what the file used to say**, so the next reader can tell a quotation from a claim.

### The probe

| # | leg | kind | pre | post |
|--:|:--|:--|--:|--:|
| 1 | the retired assertion in its **standing** form `does).` | must-LEAVE | **1** | **0** |
| 2 | the same text as a **quoted citation** `does)".` | must-ARRIVE | **0** | **1** |
| 3 | ⭐ **NON-COMMENT** changed lines in `ci.yml` | **must-STAY-UNCHANGED** | 57 changed | **0** |
| 4 | ⭐ `exclude,glob` rows in `ci.yml` | **must-STAY** | **15** | **15** |
| 5 | ⭐ `scripts/__tests__/ci-cd-pipeline-doc.test.ts` | **must-STAY-UNCHANGED** | — | **empty diff** |
| 6 | ⭐ `.github/workflows/lint.yml` — the card's explicit out-of-scope fence | **must-STAY-UNCHANGED** | — | **empty diff** |
| 7 | control `Decide whether this change needs a full run`, known direction | control, **HITS** | **4** | **4** |
| 8 | nonsense control `spec-symbolz` | control | **0** | **0** |

⚠️ **Legs 1 and 2 read comments DELIBERATELY** — the deliverable *is* a comment, so a comment-blind reader (`^\s*#`) scores this entire PR as a **no-op**. Leg 3 is the same reader pointed the **other** way, and that is exactly what makes it load-bearing.

⇒ ⭐ **Legs 3 + 4 together are the card's hardest fence, measured rather than promised**: 「⛔ Do NOT wire a markdown stage into either job on suspicion.」 **Zero** non-comment changed lines and the exclusion rows **unmoved at 15** ⇒ ⛔ no trigger was widened. Leg 5 is the second: the pin that reddened during development is **untouched** — the dev reworded **their own comment** instead, when weakening the gate was the other option available.

### ⛔ What this PR does NOT close, and why it lands anyway

⭐ **The re-grade condition FIRED.** `type-check` **does** read markdown — `check-spec-symbol-derivation.mjs:1731` walks `content/docs`, **184** tracked pages, of which **0** survive the decide step's exclusions (control: **5,726** files do survive). ⇒ the gate that exists *because* a wrong spec claim shipped in `content/docs/fields/lookup.mdx` is skipped on exactly the PRs that edit published prose. Card objectui#9241 is on **`pm:retriage`**, `priority:p3` deliberately **untouched** — ⛔ this seat does not grade. Options **A / B / C** are triage's; finding at objectui#9241 `#issuecomment-5652636084`.

⇒ ⚠️ This PR delivers the card's **declared scope item 3** — 「rewrite `ci.yml`'s comment so it states a measurement instead of an assertion, ⭐ **even if the answer is zero**」 — and it is **comment-only**. ⛔ Holding an accurate measurement hostage to an undecided remedy would leave a sentence in `main` that this very card has proven **false**. Whichever option triage picks edits this same comment again.
